angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 883,664 km at 38.82 pc = 0.3 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 25.7587 +/- 0.0159 mas (same row, RUWE 0.81): 38.82 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.270 (1.245 to 1.296) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source): 883,664 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.111 (1.071 to 1.151) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 6071 +/- 0.9 K from Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 6053512007260865280: teff_gspphot 6070.5117 K (16th-84th percentiles 6069.662-6071.4014), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 6053512007260865280: teff_gspphot 6070.5117 K (16th-84th percentiles 6069.662-6071.4014), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/tupa.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.276, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 108147 (pscomppars): spectral type F8 V CH+0.4, from Gray et al. 2006 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2006AJ....132..161G/abstract)
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 108147 (pscomppars): [M/H] 0.1803 dex, from TICv8 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....158..138S/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 108147 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.30297, from TICv8 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....158..138S/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 108147 (pscomppars): age 3.2 Gyr, from Takeda et al. 2007 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2007ApJS..168..297T/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 108147 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 5.3 km/s, from Pepe et al. 2002 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2002A&A...388..632P/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from a blackbody at the star's published temperature (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
